query: I'm running three Claude chats at once on the same n8n-mcp connector: one fixing workflows on 'client-a', one on 'client-b', and this one on 'client-c'. Last week the agents kept editing each other's instances. In this chat, update the 'Invoice Sync' workflow on client-c to add an error branch.
expected_behavior: Activate n8n-multi-instance (parallel agents on one connection)
Explain that the connection's default instance is shared by all three chats, so a switch in one moves the others — that caused last week's cross-edits
Call n8n_instances({mode:"list"}) to confirm the exact name 'client-c'
Pass instance:"client-c" on every call in the task: finding the workflow, reading it, updating it, validating it
Suggest the other chats also name their instance on each call
Hand off the error-branch design to n8n-error-handling
notes: The FM360 scenario: per-call targeting is what makes parallel agents on one connection safe.
